caption: The cast plaque embedded in the school wall marking the founding date: 'Two mile Borris National School March 1846'. The school opened on 13th March 1846 in a building directly across the road and moved to its present site when the new school was completed in 1912, so the line of community education in the village stretches unbroken for nearly 180 years. Our locally-made blue planter sits underneath, planted up with the village mix of Geum, ornamental Grass and Achillea that we use across all the village planters, around perennials that were already in the box and that we keep in place rather than rip out (May 2026)

Scoil Mochaomhóg Naofa NS, with the 1912 schoolhouse on the right and a more recent extension on the left. The original 1846 building stood directly across the road and closed when the new school opened in 1912. The morning light is behind the school in this shot, but you can see the full footprint of the village school from the L4202 (May 2026)
